summary: Complete testing of 'Bayar di Muka' (Initial Payment) feature in UD. Aqin Tani app. Both backend API and frontend UI tested successfully. All 6 backend tests passed (partial payment, zero payment, full payment, overpayment cap, no stock, no supplier). Frontend tests verified conditional visibility of 'Bayar di Muka' section and integration with Pembelian page.

issues: Console warning: Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent - accessibility improvement recommended (carried over from previous iteration)

passed_tests: Backend: POST /api/products with partial initial_paid creates purchase with correct paid, remaining - PASS
Backend: POST /api/products with initial_paid=0 creates purchase with full remaining debt - PASS
Backend: POST /api/products with initial_paid >= total creates fully paid purchase (remaining=0) - PASS
Backend: Overpayment (initial_paid > total) correctly capped at total - PASS
Backend: No purchase created when stock=0 - PASS
Backend: No purchase created when supplier not specified - PASS
Frontend: Add product dialog opens correctly - PASS
Frontend: 'Bayar di Muka' section hidden when stock=0 - PASS
Frontend: 'Bayar di Muka' section hidden when supplier not selected - PASS
Frontend: 'Bayar di Muka' section appears when stock > 0, supplier selected, cost_price > 0 - PASS
Frontend: 'Bayar di Muka' section NOT visible when editing existing product - PASS
Frontend: Debt calculation displayed correctly (Total - Bayar di Muka = Sisa hutang) - PASS
Frontend: Product can be created with partial payment - PASS
Frontend: Purchase record appears on Pembelian page with correct debt info - PASS

context_for_next_testing_agent: 'Bayar di Muka' (Initial Payment) feature fully functional: 1) When creating new product with stock > 0, supplier selected, and cost_price > 0, the 'Bayar di Muka' section appears in amber background. 2) Shows total purchase cost, input for upfront payment, and calculated remaining debt. 3) Purchase record automatically created with correct paid/remaining amounts. 4) Section hidden when editing existing products. 5) Purchase records visible on Pembelian page with 'Tempo' indicator for debt purchases.
